about.title: 关于我们
about.description: Villa Venere 是一座迷人的海景别墅，靠近切塔拉的海滩和镇中心。别墅设有三间卧室、两间浴室、舒适客厅、配备电磁炉的厨房，以及俯瞰古塔和港口的全景露台，并拥有私人入海通道。

photoExperience.title: 从每一处风景认识 Villa Venere
photoExperience.intro: 从全景露台到面朝蔚蓝大海的客房，在抵达前先探索整栋别墅。
photoExperience.seaDescription: 从别墅步行至水边的专属平台，远离拥挤的海滩。
photoExperience.privateRelax: A quiet space for your group
photoExperience.roomsTitle: 三间客房，一座海景之家
photoExperience.roomsIntro: 明亮的双人房和灵活的睡眠空间，适合家庭与团体。
photoExperience.kitchenText: Everything you need for breakfast, an aperitif or dinner at home.
photoExperience.bathroomsText: Comfortable spaces with showers, towels and a washing machine.
photoExperience.flexibleText: Additional sofa beds allow the whole group to stay together.
photoExperience.momentsTitle: 阿马尔菲海岸的慢时光
photoExperience.momentsIntro: 露台早餐、按摩浴缸和远望海岸灯火的夜晚。
photoExperience.hotTubMoment: Relax, with the coast around you
photoExperience.hostDescription: 从第一次咨询到抵达切塔拉，Martina 都会亲自回复。
